candidates.buyer: Small FSM employers and sole traders (shops, family firms) and the local bookkeepers who file for them
candidates.category: 31/32. GRT, wage-tax and FSMSSA employer returns
candidates.existing: Free state portal (RMS / e-tax.gov.fm) now covers GRT and withholding filing; consultancy Aviaan (aviaanaccounting.com) markets bookkeeping and payroll services in Micronesia; no FSM-specific software found. Competitor search 'Pohnpei bookkeeping payroll tax preparation ... software' found no product.
candidates.known_note: Related to K01 (VAT / revenue authority kit) but different duty: existing quarterly taxes, not VAT.
candidates.name: Small-employer quarterly compliance kit: wage tax + GRT + Social Security return in one workflow (paper SSA side plus accrual bookkeeping)
candidates.trigger: Quarterly: GRT and wage-tax returns online at e-tax.gov.fm (FSM Code Title 54; Q2 2026 deadline 31 July 2026); FSMSSA Employer's Quarterly Tax Return (FSM Code Title 53 ch. 9; 7.5% + 7.5%), with Business Gross Revenue form attached in Q4. GRT must be computed on accrual basis with no expense deductions.
candidates.unchecked: Whether FSMSSA has any e-filing; whether RMS allows agents/accountants to file for clients; whether the VAT start date (K01) will force a combined return; actual number of small employers (population ~115k); willingness to pay.

candidates.buyer: Self-employed persons with no employees and small family firms
candidates.name: Household and sole-trader Social Security 'No Payroll' / zero-return reminder service
candidates.trigger: FSMSSA requires a quarterly return even with no payroll (No Payroll This Quarter box) and a copy of the Business Gross Revenue form in Q4.
candidates.unchecked: Penalty size, how many filers are zero filers, whether this is real pain; a feature of C01, not a standalone product.

candidates.name: Insurance agent/broker licence tracker (Title 37 Insurance Act 2006)
candidates.trigger: FSM Code Title 37 ch. 3: licence per insurer for each agent; Banking and Insurance Board; CB 16-07 proposes broker indemnity cover.
candidates.unchecked: Number of licensed agents (likely tens); renewal cycle; fees. Too small to sustain a product.

candidates.buyer: Owners of commercial boats under 12 m (water taxis, dive boats, ferries, fishing skiffs)
candidates.name: Small commercial vessel annual inspection and operator licence manager
candidates.trigger: FSM Small Vessel Regulations (National Maritime Act 1997): initial inspection, periodic inspection at least every 12 months, $50 annual fee, operator licence, vessel marking.
candidates.unchecked: Whether inspections are actually enforced; fleet size; state-level overlays (Kosrae Title 16 ch. 2 and Title 19 ch. 3 fishing vessel registration). Very small fleet and low fee.

candidates.buyer: Non-citizen business owners (retail, restaurants, construction) and employers sponsoring foreign workers
candidates.existing: Employer-of-record sites (Rivermate, RemotePeople) only explain the process
candidates.name: Foreign Investment Permit and non-citizen work/entry permit renewal tracker for employers and investors
candidates.trigger: Foreign Investment Act 1997 (permit needed to engage in business; non-transferable); employer-sponsored work permits and entry permits (Worker) per state Division of Immigration and Labor, 1-2 years renewable; 2002 moratorium PL 12-13 may still limit categories.
candidates.unchecked: Current permit counts, whether moratorium is in force, fees, renewal and reporting duties after issue. Likely handled by lawyers on paper.

candidates.name: Sakau bar and food premises sanitation-certificate compliance (Pohnpei EPA)
candidates.trigger: Pohnpei EPA sakau bar regulation: operational and sanitation standards; certificate of compliance displayed (issued under 2000 cholera emergency order and State Law 3L-26-92).
candidates.unchecked: Whether the certificate is still issued or renewed; number of bars; 2024-25 amendments. Informal, offline sector with no payment capacity.

candidates.buyer: Small exporters of agricultural products (pepper, noni, root crops, sakau) and parcel senders
candidates.existing: None seen; Customs side covered by ASYCUDAWorld (K02)
candidates.name: Plant/animal quarantine export and import permit helper for small exporters (phytosanitary certificate)
candidates.trigger: FSM Plant and Animal Quarantine Regulations Part IV (permits for movement) and Part IX (export: phytosanitary certificates, inspection); biosecurity alerts up sharply in 2025.
candidates.unchecked: Export volumes; fees; destination rules (CNMI, Guam, US); whether permits are on paper. Tiny export base.

candidates.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and health providers
candidates.name: Medical licensing and clinic/practitioner licence renewal for private providers
candidates.trigger: FSM Medical Licensing Act (Title 41 ch. 2); board expanded to five members by Congressional Act 23-149 (January 2025); DHSA tenders require medical and business licences.
candidates.unchecked: Private provider count (very few), renewal cycles, insurer billing. Public health system dominates.

candidates.buyer: Small lenders, Development Bank of FSM loan officers, finance companies
candidates.existing: State registry itself is online and free to search
candidates.name: Secured transactions notice filing and lender-side registry upkeep
candidates.trigger: Secured Transactions Act: online notice filing at the Dept of Economic Affairs ($15 per notice); PSDI is upgrading the registry and pushing lender uptake.
candidates.unchecked: Filing volumes, who files, whether lenders need continuation tracking. Buyers are few and not 'quiet' small businesses.

coverage.category: 31. Gross receipts tax and wage-tax withholding returns (CTA, DoFA)
coverage.found: Quarterly GRT (3% above $10,000; accrual basis) and wage-tax returns are now filed online at e-tax.gov.fm; DoFA Revenue Management System (RMS) rolled out in phases, training in Pohnpei Oct 2025; Yap notice set a 31 July 2026 deadline for Q2 2026. coverage.category: 32. FSM Social Security employer quarterly return (FSMSSA)

coverage.category: 35. Secured Transactions Act collateral registry
coverage.found: Online notice filing at Dept of Economic Affairs, $15 per notice, free search (date unknown); PSDI supporting registry upgrade and lender uptake. Filers are mostly banks and the Development Bank, not quiet small firms. See C09.

coverage.found: FSM Small Vessel Regulations under National Maritime Act 1997: vessels under 12 m, initial and at least 12-monthly inspection, $50 annual fee, operator licence, marking. See C04.

coverage.found: PL 21-76 (2020) bans one-time-use styrofoam/plastic food items and shopping bags import; Pohnpei litter/waste fee law 6L-66-06; sakau bar sanitation regulation. Importer-side compliance only. See C06.

coverage.found: One search returned only foreign results; Banking Board overview page not opened. Unverifiable.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: fsmssa.fm/employers (fetched) says every employer needs an EIN and files an Employer's Quarterly Tax Return with payment each quarter, and that covered employers include sole proprietors with at least 1 employee or over $10,000 gross revenue. It lists domestic service as covered but gives no household-specific registration or reporting rule. Search snippets conflict: the 2014 FSM Code (Title 53 wages definition) appears to exclude domestic service in a private home, and bill CB 18-236 treats family employment as non-covered (enactment unconfirmed). No household register found. Small market and no distinct buyer group: nothing worth a candidate.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: One combined search with category 3 and one on vehicles returned only foreign results. No FSM or Pohnpei dealer register or scrap licence found. Title 32 Ch 1 licences only importers, exporters, securities dealers and insurers. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No FSM or state pawnbroker or second-hand dealer rule found. Business licensing is by state or municipal licence (secondary source, a third-party guide). Nothing found.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No dismantler or junk-vehicle rule found. Used-vehicle importers exist, for example Go Alpha Enterprises in Kolonia, a self-described Japan-sourced used-car dealer. No dealer register or scrapping programme surfaced.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: No slaughter or butcher licensing rule found. The FSM National Food Safety Act (PL 7-116) and DHSA food-inspector job postings (personnel.gov.fm, 2026) show food-facility inspection exists nationally, but no register or report duty was seen. Nothing for software.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: No FSM or Pohnpei well-drilling or abstraction permit found. Only the national earthmoving permit (FSM Supreme Court case citing earthmoving regulations, with a Pohnpei EPA assessment role) surfaced. That is a per-project permit with no recurring duty.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Pohnpei Utilities Corporation (PUC) runs public water under Pohnpei State Code Title 34 Ch 1. Local-government water systems are excluded unless transferred to PUC. Pohnpei EPA lab tests drinking water (zero E. coli per 100 mL). Nothing on Chuuk, Yap or Kosrae. No small-operator register or reporting duty found.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: No FSM or state pesticide dealer or applicator licensing found. Only FSM Code Title 22 Ch 4 plant and animal quarantine permits (import of plants and produce) and a regional PRPRS harmonisation effort were seen. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Nothing FSM-specific found; the search returned only foreign results. No funeral or cemetery register seen.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: No manpower-agency or security-guard licensing found. Foreign worker entry is governed by entry and work permits and an older moratorium notice (2002, currency unknown), plus the Pohnpei Residents Employment Act 1991 (text not seen). Employers also face SSA quarterly returns. No agency register found.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: No contractor licensing or site register found. FSM Code Title 32 Ch 1 (fetched) licenses only importers, exporters, securities dealers and insurers. Foreign contractors need a Foreign Investment Permit (Title 32 Ch 2), though PL 14-48 exempts Compact infrastructure civil works. A 2006 item mentions national contractor pre-qualification for government projects. No local-content report found.

coverage.category: 38. FSM Banking Board, remittances, financial institution licensing
coverage.found: bankingboard.gov.fm/overview.htm (fetched): the Board regulates only deposit-taking banks, which today are Bank of Guam and Bank of the FSM. Insurance companies, credit unions, money transfer entities, FSM Development Bank, MiCare and housing authorities are listed as non-regulated by the Board. Annual bank licence fee is $2,000 per office. No remittance licensing or reporting register at the Board. The AML law status (CB 14-205 Financial Transactions Reporting) is unconfirmed and no FSM mutual evaluation was found. Closed as a buyer group: only two regulated banks.

result.reason: Duty is real. FSMSSA requires a quarterly Employer's Quarterly Tax Return, including a "No Payroll" return, on paper, with the Business Gross Revenue form attached in Q4. I found no penalty text and no online filing on the page. Yap's notice says withholding and gross revenue tax are filed through e-tax.gov.fm, with a Q2 2026 deadline of 31 July 2026. The national RMS portal is free, and a DoFA workshop covered GRT and withholding filing. Competition: the state portal does the core filing and no FSM-specific software turned up. Market is small (population about 115k, a few thousand firms). Willingness to pay is low, and I could not confirm whether agents can file for clients. Not independently checked here: the GRT accrual basis and Title 53/54 citations, and the 7.5%+7.5% Social Security rate (older Yap guides give 12% and 15%).

decisions.reason: Quarterly GRT, wage-tax and FSMSSA employer returns are a different duty from K01 (VAT/URA transition); related to K01.
Same core duty (FSMSSA quarterly return, incl. no-payroll and Q4 gross revenue form) and overlapping sole-trader and family-firm buyers as ALL1.
Licence-per-insurer duty falls on small agents and brokers (small professional offices); no known idea covers it.
Annual inspection and operator licence for small commercial boats is a recurring mandatory duty on sole traders and family firms.
Foreign investment permit and worker/entry permit renewals are recurring duties on small employers; a new duty, not in known.
Sakau bar sanitation certificate is a mandatory duty on small licensed premises; a new duty and buyer.
Phytosanitary and quarantine permits are a different duty from K02 (customs declarations); related to K02.
Licence renewal falls on small private clinics and practitioners (in scope); verifiers can judge the market size.
Unsure whether notice filing is mandatory, since it perfects security interests and is arguably optional. Lenders are small finance firms, so keep for verification.
Same buyer group (sole proprietors and family firms) and same FSMSSA quarterly return duty as ALL1 and ALL2; ALL1 is the earliest candidate.
